description: Use for the gas bill of a household in Poland from its yearly use in kWh or m3. For the tariff rates only, use get_energy_prices. Yearly and monthly gas bill of a Polish household from the URE tariffs in force today (default seller fuel price and subscription, PSG distribution per tariff area), split into energy, distribution and fixed fees, with VAT. Give the yearly use in kWh or in m3; m3 are converted with the factor from the invoice or, without it, with the factor the PSG tariff uses for high-methane gas. When URE has approved the next tariff, the same use is also priced in the new tariff.

annualKwh.description: Yearly gas use in kWh (from the invoice). Give this or annualM3.

annualM3.description: Yearly gas use in m3. Give this or annualKwh.

area.description: PSG tariff area: key (GD, PO, TA, WA, WR, ZA) or name, e.g. "warszawski". Omit for all 6 areas.

factor.description: Conversion factor kWh/m3 from the invoice; only with annualM3.

group.description: Tariff group from the invoice; default from the yearly use (PSG thresholds in m3).

name: calc_gas_bill
title: Household gas bill calculator
